# Architecture decision records

Format: [MADR](https://adr.github.io/madr/); start new records from [template.md](template.md). A record is never rewritten after acceptance. It is superseded by a new one. **Add an ADR file; never edit the index by hand** — it is generated by `python -m quality.tools.adr_index --write` and checked by the `adr_index` gate, so parallel lanes cannot conflict on it.
